pack.name: Security Architecture Baseline
pack.description: Starter security posture checks for cloud architecture reviews — identity, network, encryption, logging, and secure SDLC. Aligned to CIS Azure Foundations and OWASP ASVS themes. Not an exhaustive compliance assessment.

rules.title: MFA enforced for privileged access
rules.description: Privileged operator and break-glass paths onto Azure control planes must assume phishing-resistant MFA; manifests should evidence Entra Conditional Access posture where extractor switches captured identity exports.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document MFA + CA expectations in governance.RequiredControls and tie AuthenticatesWith edges to identity planes; cite extractor ScopeDescriptor when uploads cover subscription IAM exports.

frameworkMappings.control: 1 Identity and Access Management — MFA enforcement themes

frameworkMappings.requirement: V2 Authentication — multi-factor controls for privileged accounts (thematic)

rules.title: Workload authentication uses managed identity
rules.description: Azure workloads reaching SQL, Key Vault, Storage, or ARM should prefer managed identities over long-lived client secrets embedded in apps.
rules.remediationGuidance: Flag MI adoption on services[].Tags and governance.PolicyConstraints; avoid WritesTo paths that imply secret-bearing connection strings without Key Vault intermediation.

frameworkMappings.control: 1. Ensure use of IAM-managed credentials / MI patterns

rules.title: Secrets not stored in source repositories
rules.description: Connection strings, SAS tokens, and API keys must not be authoritative in CI-visible source; manifests should reflect Key Vault or platform secret stores.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record secret-handling rules in governance.PolicyConstraints and require Key Vault or managed-secret surfaces on ReadsFrom/WritesTo datastore edges.

rules.title: RBAC least privilege applied
rules.description: Role assignments should follow least-privilege defaults for operators and workloads; overly broad Owner/Contributor on production scopes must be justified.
rules.remediationGuidance: Encode RBAC posture narratives in governance.RequiredControls and ComplianceTags; pair with extractor SubscriptionId / ScopeDescriptor citations when IAM dumps accompany the package.

rules.title: Conditional access policies documented
rules.description: Organization-specific Conditional Access signals (risk-based policies, compliant devices) should appear as documented assumptions where they gate Azure entry.
rules.remediationGuidance: Add CA documentation strings to governance.PolicyConstraints and metadata.ChangeDescription for the manifest snapshot under review.

rules.title: Data stores avoid public internet exposure
rules.description: PaaS data planes (SQL, storage, Cosmos, Redis) must not rely on implicit public access where Private Link or firewall constraints are expected.
rules.remediationGuidance: Set PrivateEndpointRequired true on sensitive datastores[] and narrate firewall stance in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Private endpoints for sensitive PaaS
rules.description: High-risk services should declare Private Link expectations consistent with segmented landing zones.
rules.remediationGuidance: Require PrivateEndpointRequired on datastore rows tied to PHI/PCI scopes and mirror Tags on consuming services[].

rules.title: NSG or firewall rules posture cited
rules.description: East-west and north-south filtering expectations should be traceable via governance narrative when extractor captures network inventories.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture NSG/firewall summaries in governance.PolicyConstraints or ComplianceTags and cite extractor SwitchesUsed when network snapshot switches were enabled.

rules.title: East-west traffic segmented
rules.description: Tier-to-tier lateral movement should encounter documented segmentation boundaries aligned with workload sensitivity.
rules.remediationGuidance: Model segmentation via relationships and governance.RequiredControls naming subnet/service tiers.

rules.title: Private DNS resolution for Private Link
rules.description: Private Endpoint deployments should assume integrated DNS resolution patterns so split-horizon gaps do not leak traffic publicly.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note DNS integration obligations in governance.PolicyConstraints alongside PrivateEndpointRequired=true rows.

frameworkMappings.control: 7 DNS integration with Private Link themes

rules.title: Encryption at rest enforced
rules.description: Azure-managed CMK posture aside, manifests must flag EncryptionAtRestRequired for persisted sensitive datasets.
rules.remediationGuidance: Ensure EncryptionAtRestRequired=true on regulated datastores[] and cite CMK/HSM expectations in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: TLS 1.2 or higher for data in transit
rules.description: HTTPS/TLS minimums must apply at ingress and between services where extractor or manifest exposes listeners.
rules.remediationGuidance: Encode TLS minimums in governance.PolicyConstraints and service Tags for API gateways / App Services.

rules.title: Key rotation policy documented
rules.description: Cryptographic keys for workloads should show rotation cadence ownership even when Azure platform-managed defaults apply.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture rotation cadence in governance.PolicyConstraints referencing Key Vault runtime surfaces.

rules.title: Certificate management automated
rules.description: Public endpoints relying on TLS must describe automation for issuance and renewal (Key Vault / App Service managed certs).
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe renewal automation in governance.RequiredControls on edge services[].

rules.title: Centralized logging enabled
rules.description: Platform diagnostics should converge to Log Analytics / sentinel-ready workspaces when Azure workloads emit audit planes.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag observability sinks on services[].Tags and cite extractor RawJson summaries when diagnostic settings exports exist.

frameworkMappings.control: 5 Logging and Monitoring — centralized sinks themes

rules.title: Security events forwarded to SIEM
rules.description: High-value audit streams (Entra sign-ins, Key Vault, subscription activity) should route to SOC-visible pipelines.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture forwarding commitments in governance.RequiredControls and ComplianceTags tied to SIEM destinations.

rules.title: Alerting on authentication failures
rules.description: Auth anomaly alerting expectations must exist where workload exposes interactive or machine authentication planes.
rules.remediationGuidance: Bind alert posture language to governance.PolicyConstraints and AuthenticatesWith relationships.

rules.title: Resource change auditing captured
rules.description: Subscription-level mutations should remain observable via Activity Log retention assumptions referenced in governance narrative.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note Activity Log / Defender Cloud posture in governance.PolicyConstraints; cite extractor CollectionTimestamp for freshness.

frameworkMappings.requirement: V7 Logging coverage for privileged actions (thematic)

rules.title: Log retention meets minimum enterprise baseline
rules.description: Retention targets (≥90 days for security-relevant logs) should appear as documented policy even when storage tier choices vary.
rules.remediationGuidance: Encode retention commitments in governance.PolicyConstraints referencing centralized logging sinks.

rules.title: Default branch protection enforced
rules.description: Production-bound repositories must enforce protected default branches preventing direct pushes.
rules.remediationGuidance: Reflect SDLC posture in governance.PolicyConstraints or ComplianceTags referencing CI/CD integration surfaces.

frameworkMappings.requirement: V15 Secure coding lifecycle — SCM protections (thematic)

rules.title: Peer code review required for merges
rules.description: Human review gates reduce unauthorized configuration drift reaching manifests promoted to golden snapshots.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture PR review obligations in governance.RequiredControls tied to CI/CD services[].

rules.title: Dependency scanning enabled in CI
rules.description: Third-party packages feeding Azure-deployed workloads must pass organizational SCA thresholds.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note SCA tooling expectations in governance.PolicyConstraints referencing pipeline services[].

rules.title: Container images scanned prior to deploy
rules.description: Images destined for AKS / Container Apps must show vulnerability scanning commitments.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag container hosts with scanning expectations and relate registry relationships explicitly.

rules.title: Infrastructure-as-code scanned in CI
rules.description: Terraform/Bicep/ARM templates governing Azure deployments should undergo static analysis prior to apply.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe IaC scanning gates in governance.PolicyConstraints aligned with IaC publishing services[].

rules.title: Secrets scanning before commit
rules.description: Pre-commit or CI secrets scanners must guard against accidental leakage of tokens coinciding with extractor uploads.
rules.remediationGuidance: Encode mandatory secret scanning in governance.RequiredControls adjacent to repository integration surfaces.

rules.title: Runtime secrets retrieved via Key Vault (or equivalent vault)
rules.description: Workload connection strings, certificates, and API keys should resolve through Azure Key Vault references or managed secret APIs—not persistent plaintext in App Settings, container env blocks, or CI-visible parameter files.
rules.remediationGuidance: Model vault-backed retrieval on WritesTo/ReadsFrom edges and governance.RequiredControls; tag services with KeyVaultReference=true style hints where manifests capture deployment posture.

frameworkMappings.control: 8 Key Vault usage / secret store integration themes

rules.title: Legacy TLS protocols disabled at ingress
rules.description: Public and internal HTTPS listeners must disable TLS 1.0/1.1 and organization-disallowed cipher suites; manifests should record minimum TLS policy intent at gateways and app hosts.
rules.remediationGuidance: Encode TLSMinimumVersion and cipher posture strings in governance.PolicyConstraints and edge service Tags (APIM, Front Door, App Service).

frameworkMappings.control: 8 Encryption in transit — protocol minimum themes

frameworkMappings.requirement: V9 Communications — cipher and protocol minimums (thematic)

rules.title: Private endpoints mandatory for regulated-class datastores
rules.description: When governance labels imply regulated payloads (PHI/PCI-equivalent tags), backing PaaS stores must declare PrivateEndpointRequired and avoid reliance on public network paths.
rules.remediationGuidance: Set PrivateEndpointRequired=true on tagged datastores[], align ComplianceTags with segmentation narrative, and cite extractor scope when inventories justify exceptions.

frameworkMappings.control: 7 Private Endpoint enforcement for sensitive data planes (thematic)

frameworkMappings.requirement: V1 Architecture — regulated data enclave expectations (thematic)

rules.title: Edge WAF or equivalent inspection for internet-facing APIs
rules.description: Externally reachable HTTP APIs should sit behind Web Application Firewall policies (managed rules or vetted equivalent) with documented exception handling.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note WAF attachment on ingress services[].Tags and governance.RequiredControls; relate AuthenticatesWith/APIM edges explicitly.

frameworkMappings.requirement: V13 Request handling protections at the perimeter (thematic)

rules.title: Just-in-time or time-bound privileged access documented
rules.description: Break-glass and standing Owner/Contributor assignments should be minimized; manifests should reference JIT/PIM-style elevation expectations for cloud administrators.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture JIT/PIM posture in governance.PolicyConstraints alongside RBAC narratives (sec-base-004 complement); cite Identity governance attachments when uploaded.

frameworkMappings.requirement: V4 Access Control — privileged session boundaries (thematic)
